title: Playboy Magazine June 1970 Complete With Centerfold Playmate Of The Year
descriptionText:
This vintage Playboy Magazine from June 1970 is a must-have for collectors and history buffs alike. Complete with its original centerfold, this issue features the Playmate of the Year and is illustrated with stunning photography and modelling. The magazine is in physical format and published in English, with a monthly frequency. 

The publication name is Playboy (Pre-1980) and the topics covered include photography, men's interest, and modelling. The magazine is perfect for those interested in art and photography, as well as those who appreciate the history of these topics. The features of this magazine are sure to impress, making it a valuable addition to any collection.
